name: audit-ratchet
description: A coverage ratchet for mutation handlers: every exported handler under a directory must reach an audit sink with a namespaced action, or carry a justified exemption, and the list of known-unaudited handlers may shrink but never grow.
author: Mike Pointer <mpointer@gmail.com>

scripts.lint: node --check bin/audit-ratchet.js && for f in src/*.js; do node --check $f; done
